changes.title: Accurate group comparisons
changes.text: Repeated statistic labels keep their own values instead of borrowing the last matching label from the other group.

changes.title: Retain the repeated-label regression
changes.text: A controlled one-method baseline and the full gate require two same-label statistics to remain paired by definition order.

changes.title: Preserve TEST254 delivery and candidate evidence
changes.text: Keep exact published-source receipts, unsuccessful supplemental attempts and the TEST254 rollback while the new source is verified.

changes.title: Record the bounded UIMSD correction
changes.text: Document the reproduced mismatch, exact baseline evidence, pending full verification and unchanged gameplay/scoring limits.

commentary: A group comparison treated display labels as unique identifiers. The retained regression proves that two distinct Average rows could both show group B's later value; pairing the same-schema lines by definition order fixes only report presentation.
